request.style: English, melancholic folk ballad, male and female duet, solo piano, cello, soft acoustic guitar, sparse and aching, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the garden God had planted every tree was good for food
And the tree of life was growing where the tree of knowledge stood
Then the serpent, more cunning than any creature of the field
Whispered did God really say, and the doubt began to build

[Verse]
You will certainly not die, you'll be like God, the serpent lied
So she took the fruit and ate it, gave her husband at her side
Then the eyes of both were opened and they knew that they were bare
So they sewed the fig leaves together, hid among the trees in fear

[Chorus]
In the cool of the day
The LORD God called to the man
Where are you
Where are you
I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid
So I hid

[Verse]
Thorns and thistles in the ground, and bread by sweat of brow
The flaming sword is at the gate, there's no way back in now
For dust you are, and to dust you will return
East of Eden walking out, with a lesson hard to learn

[Chorus]
In the cool of the day
The LORD God called to the man
Where are you
Where are you
I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid
So I hid

[Bridge]
Yet before they left the garden
The LORD God made garments of skin for the man and his wife
And clothed them
And a word was left behind for the serpent's ear
He will strike your head

[Outro]
Where are you
Where are you
